name: Ajivasan Chembur, Suresh Wadkar's Academy of Music, Dance and Art
description:
Ajivasan Music Academy values the philosophy of Guru Shishya Parampara, which comes from the belief of a Guru passing on knowledge to his/her student and thereby showing them how to live and breathe the art form.
Ajivasan carries forward with it a legacy of over 90 years old, thereby setting a substantial precedent in delivering top notch music education to aspiring singers & musicians.
Ajivasan is a one-stop solution for anyone who aspires to be an all round musician. Focused learning and in depth knowledge in each subject is provided by our highly qualified faculty, who are adept in different genres and excel in what they do, along with being upskilled and mentored by Suresh Wadkar ji, Prem didi and Padma Wadkar ji, regularly.
